nodes.label: Batch 6 MC-27..35 'Time' row definitions
nodes.rationale: From OWED-EXPANSIONS-2 and authoritative; rows 27-35 sit outside the stale range 13-21, which is why this file can be taken as current.

nodes.label: MC-27 — the occupancy clock and definability != reachability
nodes.rationale: The clock never rises, has three strata, and ticks at k - g; lattice-comparability and composition-reachability agree on only 0.4 per cent of pairs (11.4 against 24.7). Nine is the unique dimension where time exists.

nodes.label: MC-29 — the DECAY THEOREM
nodes.rationale: MRF on a tree gives conditional independence, then data-processing, then Pinsker: agreement decays with tree distance and the chain fails at a cycle. Owed: the full proof, the mutual-information decay and the cycle falsifier.

nodes.label: MC-30 — past / present / future is a path, not a triangle
nodes.rationale: Future is independent of past given present; the saturated bracket and the 350/350 tick from two sources. Owed: the two-sided-cut equals internal-degree-2-vertex proof.

nodes.label: MC-33 — the fourteenth axis, THE BOUNDARY
nodes.rationale: Bounded but not built: fill is monotone decreasing by construction and converges into [0, 0.42 per cent], but the limit value is undetermined. The null is definable and E = 0 is necessary but not sufficient — the boundary has to be grounded from inside and reconciled with the Preface spine.

nodes.label: MC-35 — exactness implies not-a-triangle (M-flagged, load-bearing)
nodes.rationale: Treewidth 1 closes exactly and treewidth 2 gives only an envelope; a triangle on {past, present, future} would be treewidth 2; Lambda closes exactly, so the graph is treewidth 1 and carries no past-future edge. M flagged it to be fully represented rather than folded into MC-30 as a remark, and tied to the three-body shape of register 316 as the treewidth-2 case.

nodes.label: MC-31 — two indices and a union that does not exist
nodes.rationale: rev(Lambda-9) is lawful but is not Lambda-9; their intersection is a groupoid of 389 cells at g = q = k; the union carries E = 2,857 and so does not exist as an index.
